mapper.sql: select lock_id, order_id, order_item_id, warehouse_id, product_id, location_id, batch_no, stock_id, locked_qty, released_qty, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from wms_stock_lock
mapper.select: where order_id = #{orderId} and status = '0' order by lock_id asc for update
mapper.insert: insert into wms_stock_lock ( order_id, order_item_id, warehouse_id, product_id, location_id, batch_no, stock_id, locked_qty, released_qty, status, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{warehouseId}, #{productId}, #{locationId}, #{batchNo}, #{stockId}, #{lockedQty}, #{releasedQty}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update wms_stock_lock set released_qty = #{releasedQty}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where lock_id = #{lockId}
